create_BatchItem: create a BatchItem with metadata and tensors for a single batch element
build_Batch_collate: build a Batch by collating a list of BatchItem objects together
iterate_Batch_index: iterate over a Batch or index into it to retrieve individual BatchItem objects
apply_function_Batch: apply a function to all tensors in a Batch and return a new Batch
move_Batch_cuda: move all tensors in a Batch to GPU with cuda or cpu_ for inplace device transfer
